contract.inputTrust: platformAdapterAssertion is solely a future real adapter prerequisite, not proof created by constructing a value. No real production adapter or account/certificate/profile inspection was added.
contract.inputInventory: Complete supported application/widget/share identity inventory; each role and bundle ID once, explicit parent and prefix relationships, same Team within each snapshot and exact mapping between snapshots. Extra/unknown extensions must not be omitted by the future adapter.
contract.identity: Opaque non-secret account binding plus per-role Team/App-ID-prefix/application-identifier comparisons; Team and App ID prefix are not assumed identical.
contract.entitlements: Known arrays required; nil unknown is rejected, empty known arrays are allowed. App Group sets match; keychain arrays including the default first group match. Duplicate/wildcard/invalid or oversized groups reject.
contract.renewalVersionScope: Same version AND build deliberately allowed. Any different per-role version/build is outside this narrow renewal policy, not a judgment that all upgrades/downgrades are prohibited.
contract.validity: Caller provides now. Each candidate interval is finite, ordered and valid at notBefore-inclusive/expiresAt-exclusive evaluation. An old installed authorization expiry does not prevent recovery identity comparison.
contract.result: metadataCompatible ReplacementPreflightPlan or fixed enum rejection. The plan binds both input snapshot IDs, three role mappings and earliest candidate authorization expiry. It executes nothing.
contract.gates: Authenticated transport, real signing adapter, revalidation of actual candidate/identities at use, installation and data-retention verification remain required; this does not integrate or bypass signerIntegration.
contract.rejectionPrivacy: Only fixed snapshot kinds/roles/field categories/reasons, no account or Team values.
contract.effects: Pure synchronous value comparison: no IO, clock access, logging, Task/queue, persistence, signer/install call, UI or probe mutation.

plannedTests.inputs: Owned synthetic adapter assertions only; no cryptographic, certificate/profile, account or device verification.

remaining: Actual Apple SDK compilation and five source-bound real Swift test executions
Future real platform adapters must establish trustworthy immutable snapshots and complete inventories before use
Authenticated install transport, signer, installation and data preservation remain separate unimplemented/unaccepted gates
